Tom and Anna had great fun there. The chat group is one of the best places in the city. Anna's birthday is in January. What's more, the little terrier barks at every delivery van.
Tom thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. There are always many people at the club room. Both of them like rice and tea. Also, my advisor helped me plan next term's courses.
Life is full of small surprises. Tom borrowed a book about art from the bookstore. Anna is interested in singing. What's more, he lost his new sunglass case at the pool.
Tom hopes to visit London one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the chat group by bike. Tom drinks tea after doing sports.
